answer: The Sybil defence is a stake bond scaled by how isolated an identity looks. A new agent is an island: it must post a bond far larger than its expected epoch payout, burned if replayed attestations or lockstep voting are detected. Agents that build a dense, varied ledger unlock a velvet discount, since faking that depth is slow and costly. Colluding keys form one cluster, so N fake agents cost N full bonds while sharing a payout that never scales linearly. Every forged sonnet of attestations is paid for in capital the attacker can lose outright.
